apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store URLs (apps.apple.com/us/app/instagram/id389801252), numeric app IDs (389801252) or app names (Instagram). Names resolve to the best match of Apple's search.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes, e.g. us, gb, de, fr, jp. Reviews are per storefront, so add several to cover more. Empty = the country in the app URL, else us.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Newest first, or most helpful first.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per app and country
maxReviews.description: Apple's feed exposes at most 500 reviews per app and country (10 pages of 50). You are charged per review.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).

maxRating.title: Maximum rating
maxRating.description: Keep only reviews with at most this many stars. Use 1-2 to find complaints.

since.title: Since
since.description: Only reviews on or after this date, e.g. 2026-01-31. With newest-first sorting the scan stops as soon as older reviews appear.
